landing.honestBody: We don't promise you'll be rich in 60 days — nobody honest can. We promise a real path: show up ~30 minutes a day, complete the missions, and you'll know exactly what to do next, including the unglamorous parts like fees, taxes on payouts, and how money actually reaches bKash. LaunchPilot never touches your marketplace account. It's free, and after your first real earning, you pay what you think it was worth.
